method.starts: first day of each calendar quarter 2018-07-01..2023-07-01 (21 starts)
method.weekly_window: 156 weeks from first Monday on/after quarter start (SPEC weekly engine trades only Mondays)
method.daily_4h_window: 1095 days from quarter start 00:00 UTC (C2, C5 daily; C9 4h bars fully inside window)
method.capital: $100 cash at window start; indicators from prior data; C2/C9 continuous signal state from full history (as in original code); C5 fresh start in USDT (frozen rule 'Start in USDT', original primary convention); continuous-state C5 reported as info only
method.bench_conventions: weekly: buy at first Monday open, mark at close, no exit cost (as SPEC engine); C2/C5/C9: buy first open, sell at last close with cost (as original SPEC2 code)
method.verdict_rule: SPEC2: FAIL if net<=0 or PF<1 or worse than B&H on BOTH net and maxDD (tie tol 0.01 pp); INCONCLUSIVE if <30 trades (C9 only); PASS_CANDIDATE if net>0, PF>=1.2, net/|maxDD| > B&H, net>0 at 2x costs; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. PF for S2/S6 from round trips (open position at window end valued at last close net of exit cost); PF not applicable for S1 (never sells); PF=inf when no losing trades.
method.survivor_bar: PASS_CANDIDATE in >50% of windows AND no FAIL window

C2_FUNDING_OVERHEAT_FILTER.bench: BTC buy&hold (buy first open, sell last close, 20 bps/side)

C5_FEAR_GREED_CONTRARIAN.bench: BTC buy&hold (buy first open, sell last close, 20 bps/side)
